profile.headline: Software Engineer at Google
profile.summary: Hwanju Kim received his Ph.D. in Computer Science from KAIST in 2013 and his B.S in Information and Computer Engineering from Ajou University in 2006. His research interests are in the area of computer systems with the particular focus on efficient resource management of operating systems and hypervisors.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description: Spanner core query processing team - TL for distributed query execution

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Spanner - query execution, scalable full text search

positions.title: Senior Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
Kinesis Data Analytics - Stream processing systems (Apache Flink)
• High availability for stream applications

positions.title: Software Development Engineer II
positions.description:
Kinesis Data Analytics - Stream processing system 
• Apache Flink - Stream application availability monitoring framework

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Isilon Storage Division: OneFS core filesystem team
• Designed and developed persistent file caching in distributed file systems (OneFS) –
Inode multiplexing, snapshot support for write/truncate/delete, cache invalidation, unit testing framework/tools (Patent - "Persistent cache layer in a distributed file system" US 10146694)
• Improved the performance of distributed in-memory writeback cache.
• Owned OneFS quotas campaign resolving scalability issues in customer sites.
• Owned OneFS caching campaign team with roadmap.
• Taking rotational role for bug triage, escalation, data corruption issues.
• Mentoring junior engineers at local and remote offices.

positions.title: Research Associate
positions.description:
Worked on Network-as-a-Service project in the NetOS group.
- Developed Linux Ethernet device driver and kernel-bypassing library for NetFPGA-10G
Public: https://github.com/NetFPGA/NetFPGA-public/wiki/Linux-Device-Driver---NIC-NaaS
Code: https://github.com/NetFPGA-NewNIC/linux-driver

- Developed Xen mini-os PVH support
Adopted to ClickOS v0.2: https://github.com/cnplab/clickos/releases/tag/v0.2
Code: https://github.com/cnplab/mini-os/commit/ae9a7bf10d6620d196dece2b7bfd186d4bcbd908

positions.title: Postdoctoral Researcher
positions.description:
Implementing a new CPU scheduler for KVM/SPICE virtual desktop infrastructure.
- Published in VEE'14: http://dl.acm.org/citation.cfm?id=2576195.2576199
- Code: https://github.com/virtualAMP

Request-oriented durable write caching project
- Published in USENIX ATC'15: http://dl.acm.org/citation.cfm?id=2813782

positions.title: Research Intern
positions.description:
- Characterizing and improving end-to-end query latency of the Bing index servers: Implemented IP multicast-based distributed optimization of ranking for low end-to-end query latency
- Analyzing parallelism technique to reduce tail latency (published in ASPLOS'16: http://dl.acm.org/citation.cfm?id=2872370)

positions.title: Ph.D.
positions.description:
Research on efficient resource management (CPU, I/O, memory) for virtualized systems
Performance analysis and optimization on operating systems and virtual machine monitors

educations.schoolName: Korea Advanced Institute of Science and Technology

projects.title: CPU scheduling for virtualized systems
projects.description:
Design and implementation of CPU scheduling schemes in real-world hypervisors (Xen and KVM) for diverse workloads including I/O-intensive, multimedia, user-interactive, and parallel workloads
- Task-aware VM scheduling [VEE'09][JPDC'11]
- VM scheduling for multimedia [MMSys'12]
- Demand-based coordinated scheduling for multiprocessor VMs [ASPLOS'13]

projects.title: Memory management for virtual machines
projects.description:
Design and implementation of memory management schemes, especially memory oversubscription, for highly consolidated virtual machines
- Efficient cooperative caching [IEEE TC'11]
- Group-based memory oversubscription [VHPC'11]

publications.title: Demand-Based Coordinated Scheduling for SMP VMs
Scheduler Support for Video-oriented Multimedia on Client-side Virtualization

patents.title: Persistent cache layer in a distributed file system
